第6章女神
夜空下，一道银光划过，并逐渐接近，向着校区深处落去。
“新星的飞碟，是女神回来了？”秦诚抬头，拉上王煊就走，要过去看一看。
校区中有一个停机坪，设施较为完善。
王煊道：“是你的女神，别拉上我。”
他觉得，秦诚安静时有些感性，但激动起来时又有些毛躁，比如现在就很不靠谱。
“其实一样的，你要知道，几乎所有人都承认她是女神。”秦诚非要拉着他一起过去。
用他的话说，看一眼少一眼了，过几天可能就再也见不到了，此生再无缘。
王煊无言，这是什么话，真是你心中的女神吗？总有种去看遗容的错觉。
“你放心，我这是纯欣赏，我是有女朋友有原则的人！”秦诚强调。
王煊想了想，那片区域距离林教授的住所较近，他确实要过去看一看，老教授过几天也要离开旧土了。
事实上，前几天林教授就和他通过电话，让他有时间过去坐一坐。
他明白老人的心意，应该是想和他商议下，看看怎么帮他，获取一个前往新星的名额。
王煊一向不愿给人添麻烦，尤其是，他知道旧术研究这个项目背后投资方的行事风格，外人很难插手。
他尊重老教授，知道他对自己好，这样就更不愿意看到老人因为他去找投资方而被拒绝。
校园很大，距离有些远，当王煊与秦诚接近时，停机坪那里早已寂静，估计人都走远了。
王煊看了一眼那架银灰色的飞碟，对秦诚道：“你自己过去看你的女神吧，我去林教授那里坐会儿。”
“算了，黑灯瞎火的跟过去，别被赵清菡误会，万一有保镖跟着，挨顿揍都没地方说理去，我和你一起去看望林教授。”
临到最后秦诚又怂了，决定做个有原则、对得起女友的好男人。
林教授的住所是一座小院，距离这里不过几百米，很快他们就到了，在院外他们意外遇到一个人。

赵清菡，也就是秦诚口中的女神，在校园中人气非常高，确实极美。
路灯下，她一头及肩的发丝在微风中飘起几缕，莹白的瓜子脸，非常漂亮的双眼清澈明亮，红唇有光泽，面孔清秀甜美。
她上身的白衬衣第一个扣子没有系，领口敞开，微露锁骨，白皙晶莹，下身则是休闲长裤，穿着相当随意。
但是，她依旧给人非常惊艳的感觉，在夜色下竟有些晃人眼。
“赵清菡。”秦诚喊道，没有想到在林教授的住所外看到她。
“是你们呀，这么巧。”赵清菡笑着打招呼，清新美丽，道：“林教授很久未回去了，有人托我给他送些新星的特产。”
看的出来，她晚间简单的穿着搭配，是为了自身的舒适，但这样也难掩她的好身材。
她身高能有一百七十几公分，该有曲线的地方弧度惊人，双腿笔直修长，身材极佳，再加上少见的美貌，确实非常吸引人的目光。
“送新星特产啊，有我们的吗？”秦诚笑着问，自来熟的拉近距离。
几名黑衣人迅速出现，很警惕地看了过来。
秦诚神色微僵，他就这么给人很不安全的感觉吗？他觉得自己长相还可以，面色和善，怎么就被人这么不信任呢。
“他们两个是我同学，你们不需要这样。”赵清菡摆手示意，让几名黑衣人不用过于紧张。
然后，她又笑着对王煊与秦诚挥手，道：“我先走了，刚从新星过来有点疲累，困死了。”
直到走出去很远后，赵清菡才止步问几名黑衣人，刚才为什么那样戒备？
“那个年轻人很厉害，被他看了几眼后，我们觉得非常危险。”一个黑衣男子回应道。
赵清菡先是吃了一惊，然后她又笑了，在晚风中如明艳的花朵绽放，灿烂而美丽。
“秦诚？不可能，真要动手的话，他远不是我的对手。”
如果秦诚在这里听到，一定有些想哭，他眼中的女神认为他毫无威胁，很弱，连她都打不过。
黑衣男子摇头，道：“不是他，是另外那个只对你笑着打招呼却没怎么开口的青年，被他扫视后，我们都觉得不对劲儿，这个人很强。”
“你是说王煊？”赵清菡点头，若有所思，道：“我一直觉得，单以旧术而论他也不如我，现在看来，我离开的这段时间他采气成功了，可惜，刚才没有仔细看。”

她仔细回想，王煊很平和，安静，始终挂着微笑，双眼清澈有神，有一种发自骨子中的从容与自信。
似乎，他刚才没怎么看她？反而一直在静静地打量她身边的几位黑衣人。
赵清菡向后看了一眼，自语道：“后面找个机会……”
刹那间，她有所觉，数百米外的夜色下，似有人向这边看来。
赵清菡转身离去，她有种感觉，刚才回头望向林教授的小院门口时，王煊似乎觉察了，朝她这边看了一眼。
秦诚不满：“长这么大，我还是头次被人划分到危险分子当中去！”
王煊安慰他：“那几个黑衣人针对的不是你，他们是在对我戒备。”
“啊，你办了什么天怒人怨的事，该不会是以前你对赵清菡做过什么吧？”秦诚的联想相当丰富。
“想什么呢，我刚才觉得那几人实力还行，想看看他们练的是旧术，还是说走了新星的另一条路。”
秦诚的精神顿时为之一振：“行啊老王，瞧你这从容淡定的样子，不声不响，就摸了人家的根底，怎么样？”
王煊立刻给他纠正：“你把称呼给我改了！”
秦诚嘿嘿直笑。
王煊思索，道：“我觉得还是旧术的路子，但举手投足间，本能反应等，又不够纯粹，似乎结合了其他路数。”
接着他又补充：“另外，赵清菡没你想象的那么柔弱，你远不是她的对手。”
“不会吧，她将旧术练到一定层次了？”秦诚顿时有些发木的感觉，喃喃道：“在刚才的一群人中，难道最弱的是我自己？”
这时院门开了，林教授出现。
“我刚送走清菡，就又听到院外传来说话声，原来是你们。”
林教授头发花白，六十几岁的样子，身体有些发福。
他当年是一个旧术高手，但曾受过很严重的伤，身体恢复的不是很好，无法再实战。
自那以后，他就专心旧术的理论研究，经文考证等，加上以前的实战经验，他在旧术探索方面很有名气。

王煊上前，开口道：“林教授，这几日一直想拜访您，但又怕给您添麻烦，所以拖到现在。”
“你呀，太见外了！”老人让他们进院子里说话，同时摇了摇头：“我确实也帮不了你，被人给拒绝了。”
王煊听到后，心头顿时一热，明白怎么回事，很感激，林教授不惜拉下老脸去找人，但投资方行事风格强硬，谁的面子都不给。
“给您添麻烦了。”王煊认真地说道，他不愿意看到林教授去求人而被拒绝的场面，心里很过意不去。
林教授摆手，不在意这些。
院子不大，栽种着一些花草，靠右手边有个鱼池，睡莲浮在水面，锦鲤摆尾游动，为小院增了不少生气。
客厅的灯光很柔和，茶几上摆放着一本相册，略显陈旧，颇有年代感。
相册翻开的那一页是个女子，处在风华正茂的年纪，罕见的美丽。
“林教授，这是谁啊？真漂亮。”秦诚问道。
“一位女画家，歌唱的也很好，红了很长时间，我们那个年代的人都很喜欢她。”林教授告知。
王煊仔细观看，相片的边角都磨损了，感觉有几十年的历史了，林教授却一直保留着它。
秦诚自然也注意到，因为很熟，所以敢开玩笑。
“您真长情，喜欢一个人几十年都没变。”
林教授点头：“是啊，我高三的时候喜欢她，现在三高了，还是喜欢她。”
王煊、秦诚发呆，都很无言。
“接下来你有什么打算？”林教授问王煊。
王煊如实告知，先去工作，但也要在旧术这条路上走下去。
“要去新星！”林教授说道。
然后他低头看相册，略微思索。
王煊赶紧开口：“林教授，你不用再为我出面去找人。”

林教授抬起头，问王煊与秦诚，道：“你们觉得，列仙存在过吗？”
王煊敏锐地发觉，刚才林教授并不是低头看那名女子的照片，而是旁边的一张。
那是一张泛黄、带着岁月感的老照片，拍摄光线不好，很模糊，但也能大致看出，像是在地底，一张石桌上有一堆竹简。
这样的竹简多见于先秦大墓中，顿时让王煊产生不少联想。
还未等王煊与秦诚回答，林教授再次开口：“你们觉得，新星那边究竟发现了什么？”

Chapter 6 Goddess
Under the night sky, a ray of silver light flashed across, gradually approached, and fell towards the depths of the campus.
"Xinxing's flying saucer, is the goddess back?" Qin Cheng raised his head, pulled Wang Xuan and left, wanting to go over and take a look.
There is a helipad on the campus with relatively complete facilities.
Wang Xuan said: "She is your goddess, don't drag me along."
He felt that Qin Cheng was a little emotional when he was quiet, but a little irritable when he was excited, and he was very unreliable now.
"Actually, it's the same. You have to know that almost everyone admits that she is a goddess." Qin Cheng insisted on pulling him over.
In his words, if you miss one glance, you may never see her again in a few days, and you may never have the chance to meet again in this life.
Wang Xuan was speechless, what are these words? Is she really the goddess in your heart? There is always the illusion of seeing the remains.
"Don't worry, I'm just appreciating this. I have a girlfriend and a principled person!" Qin Cheng emphasized.
Wang Xuan thought for a while, that area was close to Professor Lin's residence, and he really wanted to go there and have a look. The old professor would be leaving his hometown in a few days.
In fact, Professor Lin had a phone call with him a few days ago and asked him to have time to come over and sit down.
He understood the old man's intention and probably wanted to discuss with him to see how he could help him get a place to go to Xinxing.
Wang Xuan has always been unwilling to cause trouble to others, especially because he knows the behavior of the investors behind the Old Technique Research project, and it is difficult for outsiders to interfere.
He respects the old professor and knows that he is good to him, so he is even less willing to see the old man being rejected because he went to find investors.
The campus is very large and the distance is a bit far. When Wang Xuan and Qin Cheng approached, the tarmac was already quiet, and everyone was probably gone.
Wang Xuan glanced at the silver-gray flying saucer and said to Qin Cheng: "Go and see your goddess yourself. I'll go sit with Professor Lin for a while."
"Forget it, just follow him blindly. Don't let Zhao Qinghan misunderstand you. If there are bodyguards following you, you won't be able to reason with him even if you get beaten up. I'll go visit Professor Lin with you."
At the end, Qin Cheng gave up again and decided to be a good man with principles and worthy of his girlfriend.
Professor Lin's residence was a small courtyard, only a few hundred meters away. They arrived soon, and unexpectedly met a person outside the courtyard.
Zhao Qinghan, the goddess Qin Cheng calls her, is very popular on campus and is indeed extremely beautiful.
Under the street lamp, a few strands of her shoulder-length hair were fluttering in the breeze. She had a crystal-white oval face, very beautiful clear and bright eyes, glossy red lips, and a delicate and sweet face.
The first button of the white shirt on her upper body was unbuttoned, and the collar was open, slightly exposing her collarbone. She was white and translucent. Her lower body was in casual trousers, and she was dressed quite casually.
However, she still gives people a very stunning feeling, and is actually a bit dazzling in the night.
"Zhao Qinghan." Qin Cheng shouted, not expecting to see her outside Professor Lin's residence.
"It's you, what a coincidence." Zhao Qinghan greeted with a smile, fresh and beautiful, and said: "Professor Lin has not been back for a long time, and someone asked me to send him some Xinxing specialties."
It can be seen that her simple outfit in the evening is for her own comfort, but it cannot hide her good figure.
She is more than 170 centimeters tall, with amazing curves where there should be curves. Her legs are straight and slender, and she has an excellent figure. Coupled with her rare beauty, she is indeed very eye-catching.
"Send Xinxing's specialties, do you have any from us?" Qin Cheng asked with a smile, closing the distance familiarly.
Several men in black appeared quickly and looked over cautiously.
Qin Cheng's expression froze slightly. Did he make people feel insecure like this? He thought he looked okay and had a kind face, but why was he so mistrusted by others.
"The two of them are my classmates, you don't need to be like this." Zhao Qinghan waved his hand to tell the men in black not to be too nervous.
Then, she waved to Wang Xuan and Qin Cheng with a smile and said: "I'm leaving first. I just came fromXinxing came here a little tired and sleepy. "
It wasn't until he was far away that Zhao Qinghan stopped and asked the men in black, why were they so alert just now?
“That young man was very powerful, and after looking at him a few times, we felt very dangerous. "A man in black responded.
Zhao Qinghan was startled at first, and then she smiled again, blooming like bright flowers in the evening breeze, brilliant and beautiful.
"Qin Cheng? Impossible, if I really want to take action, he is far from my opponent. "
If Qin Cheng heard it here, he would definitely want to cry. The goddess in his eyes thought that he was no threat and was weak, even she couldn't beat her.
The man in black shook his head and said: "It's not him, it's the other young man who only smiled and said hello to you but didn't say much. After being glanced at by him, we all felt something was wrong. This person is very strong. "
"You mean Wang Xuan? "Zhao Qinghan nodded, thoughtfully, and said: "I have always felt that he is not as good as me in terms of old skills. Now it seems that he succeeded in collecting Qi during my absence. Unfortunately, I didn't look carefully just now. "
She recalled carefully that Wang Xuan was calm and quiet, always smiling, his eyes were clear and lively, and he had a kind of calmness and confidence that came from his bones.
It seemed that he didn't look at her much just now? Instead, she has been quietly sizing up the men in black around her.
Zhao Qinghan glanced back and said to himself: "Look for an opportunity later..."
In an instant, she felt something. In the night hundreds of meters away, someone seemed to be looking this way.
Zhao Qinghan turned and left. She had a feeling that when she turned back to look at the door of Professor Lin's small courtyard, Wang Xuan seemed to be aware of it and glanced in her direction.
Qin Cheng was dissatisfied: "In my age, this is the first time that I have been classified as a dangerous person! "
Wang Xuan comforted him: "Those men in black are not targeting you, they are wary of me. "
"Ah, you did something that made people angry. Could it be what you did to Zhao Qinghan before? "Qin Cheng's associations are quite rich.
"What are you thinking about? I just thought those people were pretty good, and I wanted to see if they were practicing old techniques, or if they were taking another path of rising stars. "
Qin Cheng's spirit suddenly lifted up: "Okay, Old Wang, look at your calm and calm look, and you touched someone's foundation without saying a word, how about it? "
Wang Xuan immediately corrected him: "You changed the title for me! "
Qin Cheng laughed.
Wang Xuan thought about it and said: "I think it is still the old technique, but the gestures, instinctive reactions, etc. are not pure enough, and it seems to be combined with other techniques. "
Then he added: "In addition, Zhao Qinghan is not as weak as you think, and you are far from her opponent. "
"No way, she has practiced the old skills to a certain level? Qin Cheng suddenly felt numb and murmured: "Among the group of people just now, am I the weakest?" "
At this time, the courtyard door opened and Professor Lin appeared.
"As soon as I saw Qinghan off, I heard voices coming from outside the hospital again. It turned out to be you. "
Professor Lin has gray hair, looks to be in his sixties, and has a somewhat overweight body.
He was an old martial arts master back then, but he suffered a serious injury and his body did not recover very well, so he could no longer fight in actual combat.
Since then, he has concentrated on the theoretical research and textual research of the old arts. Coupled with his previous practical experience, he is very famous in the exploration of the old arts.
Wang Xuan stepped forward and said: "Professor Lin, I have been wanting to visit you these past few days, but I was afraid of causing you trouble, so I have postponed it until now. "
"You are so outspoken! The old man asked them to go into the yard to talk, and shook his head at the same time: "I really can't help you. I was rejected." "
After Wang Xuan heard this, his heart suddenly became hot. He understood what was going on and was very grateful. Professor Lin did not hesitate to look for someone else, but the investors acted in a tough style and refused to give face to anyone.
"I'm causing you trouble. "Wang Xuan said seriously. He didn't want to see Professor Lin go.I felt very sad when I asked for help but was rejected.
Professor Lin waved his hand and didn't care about this.
The yard is not big, with some flowers and plants planted. There is a fish pond on the right hand side, with water lilies floating on the water and koi carps swimming with tails, which adds a lot of vitality to the small yard.
The lighting in the living room is very soft, and there is a photo album on the coffee table, which is slightly old and has a sense of age.
The page that opened in the photo album showed a woman, in her prime, with rare beauty.
"Professor Lin, who is this? So beautiful." Qin Cheng asked.
"A female painter who also sang very well was famous for a long time. People of our generation liked her very much." Professor Lin informed.
Wang Xuan looked carefully and saw that the corners of the photo were worn away. It felt like it was decades old, but Professor Lin had kept it.
Qin Cheng naturally noticed it, and because he was familiar with him, he dared to joke.
"You are so affectionate. Your love for someone has not changed for decades."
Professor Lin nodded: "Yes, I liked her when I was a senior in high school. Now that I am a senior in high school, I still like her."
Wang Xuan and Qin Cheng were in a daze, speechless.
"What are your plans next?" Professor Lin asked Wang Xuan.
Wang Xuan truthfully told him that he should go to work first, but he should also continue on the road of old skills.
"Go to Xinxing!" Professor Lin said.
Then he looked down at the photo album and thought for a moment.
Wang Xuan quickly said: "Professor Lin, you don't have to look for me anymore."
Professor Lin raised his head and asked Wang Xuan and Qin Cheng, "Do you think immortals have ever existed?"
Wang Xuan keenly realized that Professor Lin was not looking down at the photo of the woman just now, but the one next to her.
It was an old photo that was yellowed and had a sense of age. The lighting was poor and it was very blurry, but it could be roughly seen that there was a pile of bamboo slips on a stone table underground.
Such bamboo slips are often found in large pre-Qin tombs, which immediately gave Wang Xuan a lot of associations.
Before Wang Xuan and Qin Cheng could answer, Professor Lin spoke again: "What do you think they discovered at Xinxing?"
